title: Consuelo is the best of the guides!!!
text: Consuelo was an excellent and very cultured guide, highly recommended, always attentive to the group and to those who needed special attention.
author: joelcL8855YX

title: Competent and friendly guide
text: Antonio a competent guide passionate and very friendly. He guided us beautiful history in art and poetry, making us appreciate the visit so much. Thank you Antonio thank you for using your Service. David from Bologna
author: Z6350CLdavidep

title: Hector crack
text: Hector the best of all, interesting, well read on the subject and with a poetic and artistic touch that made it even more beautiful.
author: josecQ1318TH

title: Alhambra a must see to understand Southern Spain
text: The tour was excellent- great explanation of the history and the guides (Alex and Hector) were good at going between English and Spanish. Alhambra is a must see and I hope you get Hector as your guide- he’s fantastic!
author: M8604TJsamg
